subject: Issue with GSTIN on invoice INV-2526-01296
body:
Dear Royal Components & Co team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found an issue with invoice INV-2526-01296 dated 9 Sep 2025. The GSTIN on the invoice is 27FXQLM9955V5ZO, which is not valid. Our party master shows GSTIN 09FXQLM9955V5ZO. Rs 0 of input tax credit depends on this correction. Please update the GSTIN and reissue the invoice, then confirm once corrected.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
GSTIN 07AAACS1234F1ZU
